 2026EICMA: BENDA expands its motorcycle and powersports line-up
 Share this story 
 MotoPinas.com 
 November 6, 2026 - 10:37 AM 
 Benda 
 BENDA unveils Vinster 700 roadsters, Capra 700 ADV at EICMA 2026
 BENDA used EICMA 2026 to expand its motorcycle line-up with several new models, including its first entries into the roadster and adventure segments. The Chinese manufacturer also presented new ATV and snowmobile concepts as it looks to grow its presence in the European market.
 Libo Liu, General Manager of BENDA Motor Europe and Global Design Director, said its European design team plays a key role in developing products for regional customers while following the company's global design philosophy. Its stated core values are Frontier, Genuine, and Uncompromised.
 EICMA is an important opportunity for BENDA to share our vision with the international powered two-wheeler and powersports community. This year, we have demonstrated the breadth of our ambitions, presenting new concepts and models that reflect our commitment to distinctive design, engineering development and exploring new segments.
 The headline launches were the Vinster 700 and Vinster X 700 roadsters, along with the Capra 700 adventure bike. These models formed part of a wider product presentation at the show on November 3, hosted by presenter Gavin Emmett. BENDA also displayed the Dark Flag 600 Ultra EC cruiser.
 The company brought back several models first shown at EICMA 2025, including the Dark Flag 950 and Rock 707. Both are moving closer to European market availability, while the P51 boxer hybrid returned in a new color scheme. The latter was displayed in pre-production form.
 BENDA also used the event to introduce developments in its powersports range. The updated Supernovae 1000 DL now features a fully enclosed cabin, while the Redstone 400 and Redstone 850 appeared as prototypes for the company's ATV line-up.
 The Bluestone 500 R2 also made its debut. Described by BENDA as its lightest and most compact ATV yet, it is positioned as an entry-level model in the brand's utility range.
 The manufacturer also ventured into snowmobiles with the NANUQ 300 and NANUQ 1000. These models bring BENDA's design approach to a new category, with concepts aimed at recreational use and longer rides.
 The company added that it is continuing to build its global presence, with feedback from visitors, business partners, and media at EICMA forming part of that effort.
